feeds.title: LifePoint Deland Blog
feeds.description: LifePoint is a unique place with an incredible heart. As an independent non-denominational church, we are not about buildings or programs, or traditions. Simply put, we are about people. We strive to be a place where people are growing in their love for God, their love for one another, and their passion for serving.

feeds.title: LifePoint Online Blog
feeds.description: At LifePoint Church, you'll be welcomed into a friendly, casual environment by people who are excited to see you. We value the truths of the gospel and are passionate about sharing the freedom of Jesus Christ with the Pioneer Valley.

feeds.title: Life Point Church Mentor Blog
feeds.description: Pastor Ken has served as a Senior Pastor for 25 years. Under his leadership, the two churches that he pastored experienced steady growth. He has served on the COG State Council, and State World Missions board and served two terms on the State Youth and Christian Education Board. His mission is to build one life at a time by equipping people for their God-given purpose.

feeds.title: LifePoint Baptist Church Blog
feeds.description: This blog is operated by the pastors at Life Point Baptist Church in Apple Valley, California. It is intended to be a resource primarily for our congregation, but also for other Christians who are interested in the topics we discuss. Common themes in our posts are Bible application, discernment, and Christian worldview.

feeds.title: M. Lane Harrison Blog
feeds.description: Pastor Lane preaches from God's Word every Sunday. He is a church planter and lead pastor at Lifepoint Church, Ozark, Missouri. Browse the archive to watch, listen, and read his message.

feeds.title: LifePoint Ministries Blog
feeds.description: LifePoint Ministries is a community of global ministries with a vision to build healthy individuals and churches, broaden our borders to at least 75% of the counties in the state of Georgia, and create ways of bridging people to Jesus. We do this by providing leadership development opportunities, church planting essentials, and connecting others to resources for discipleship growth.

feeds.title: LifePointe Church Blog
feeds.description: LifePointe Church is a Non-Denominational Church that was founded over 11 years ago by Pastor Marvin and Leah Yoder. Pastor Matt has been involved in the church since it's conception and transitioned from the Youth Pastor to the Senior Pastor. He has been the Senior Pastor with his wife since 2019.

feeds.title: Pointtolife.net
feeds.description: This is the official blog of Life Point Baptist Church. Life Point Baptist Church supports the spread of the Gospel throughout the world by supporting missionaries who reach the lost for Christ, and who organize disciples into local churches. We also support ministries that help missionaries accomplish these goals

feeds.title: LifePoint Church NC Blog
feeds.description: At LifePoint we take very seriously the joy of the good news of Jesus Christ. You will always receive messages of undiluted grace that inspire hope, boldness, and wisdom to continue the mission of Jesus in your everyday life! We continue the mission of Jesus throughfive tangible expressions, Bless, Listen, Eat, Serve, and Share. We envision equipping believers to continue the mission of Jesus.

feeds.title: LifePoint Assembly of God Blog
feeds.description: At LifePoint you'll find a warm, caring, and exciting church made up of friendly, active, and involved people from many backgrounds, but we're on a mission, and that mission is to bring people into a growing relationship with Jesus Christ.

feeds.title: LifePoint Church AZ Blog
feeds.description: LifePoint is a fellowship of people who love Jesus and want to be like him. We are committed to following his words when he said, 'my mother and brothers are those who hear God's word and put it into practice.' Our mission is to help people become fully devoted followers of Christ through intentionally serving, giving, and caring for our neighbor. Our vision is to help you develop your full potential in Christ while we continue to start new ministries and release leaders to fulfill their God-given destinies.
